contents.name: Gentle measurement lemma (Lemma 9.4.2)
contents.detail: The finite gentle bound is re-proved by purification, a two-dimensional trace-norm calculation, and partial-trace contractivity.

contents.name: IID spectral typical projectors
contents.detail: The finite eigenvalue-window construction and the uniform heterogeneous-product Chebyshev argument are proved locally.

contents.name: Hayashi–Nagaoka operator inequality (Lemma 16.4.1)
contents.detail: The finite operator inequality is proved locally, including its singular-support case.

contents.name: Square-root measurement packing bound
contents.detail: The expected average-error estimate is proved from the local Hayashi–Nagaoka and gentle bounds.

contents.name: Schumacher quantum source coding
contents.detail: The finite source-coding theorem is carried by a complete local direct construction and strong converse.

contents.name: Finite cq-channel coding and HSW capacity
contents.detail: The random-coding achievability and Holevo/Fano/SSA converse are supplied locally for finite alphabets and outputs.

contents.name: Finite-dimensional entropy continuity
contents.detail: Continuity at zero eigenvalues is proved locally by eigenvalue perturbation and scalar continuity.

contents.name: Finite cq channel and block-code conventions
contents.detail: The local definition fixes finite input alphabet, finite output space, output states, and the tensor-product memoryless extension.

contents.name: Average-error cq block codes and operational capacity
contents.detail: The local definition specifies deterministic words, a finite decoding POVM, average block error, and nats per use.

contents.name: Schmidt-rank fidelity bound for source compression
contents.detail: The finite Kraus and Schmidt-support proof is supplied locally, including zero-padded source eigenvalues.

contents.name: Purification and finite trace-distance tools

contents.name: Finite spectral calculus and positive square roots

contents.name: Quantum source coding (Theorem 5.44)
contents.detail: The local statement makes the squared entanglement-fidelity convention and strict-rate strong converse explicit.

contents.name: Classical communication over finite cq channels
contents.detail: The local HSW proof states average-error and finite-input/finite-output hypotheses explicitly.

contents.name: Entropy continuity in finite dimensions
contents.detail: The local proof covers zero eigenvalues and fixed finite dimension.

contents.name: Finite compression and cq channel definitions
contents.detail: The local definitions fix finite reference/code spaces, natural-log units, and deterministic block-code conventions.

contents.name: Schmidt-rank converse for quantum source coding
contents.detail: The local proof bounds each composite Kraus branch by the sum of the M largest eigenvalues.
